slashCommands.workflow: Start a workflow: the maintainer lays out the steps, you authorize once, and it follows them
slashCommands.longRunning: Start a long-running task: the maintainer works in stages, and each stage is reviewed
slashCommands.interview: Start a get-to-know-you interview: one topic at a time; what you share goes into memory, and profile details are confirmed with you at the end
slashCommands.consolidate: Consolidate memory now: the same run as the nightly 03:00 one, turning collected material into conclusions
